question: interface[] has no term for a plain HTTPS download of a dataset file (a static file or a release asset, not a REST API). Add the term https-download to interface[] in scripts/dossier/schema.json and to the vocabulary tables. Then set interface of data-apis/ipinfo, data-apis/maxmind-geolite, data-apis/db-ip, data-apis/ip2location-lite, data-apis/ipapi-is and data-apis/iplocate to rest and https-download, and interface of data-apis/ip-location-db to https-download alone, because it has no API.
why: AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12: a lane does not add a vocabulary term. Each record carries rest, the nearest term, and names the download in interface_detail. A rules session adds the term in its own clone, and a later run sets the records.
